text:
Thank you for writing to Aurelia Skyways and for giving us a clear account of what went wrong with your companion animal journey; we understand that a delayed departure can be stressful for both you and your pet, and we are sorry that the experience felt disorganized and frustrating.

We take these reports seriously because safe and calm companion animal travel depends on steady communication, careful handoffs, and crews who know exactly what to do. When a departure slips, the most important things are to keep the traveler informed, protect the animal from unnecessary waiting, and make sure the onboard and ground teams stay aligned. We have reviewed the details you shared with the Companion Animal Travel Desk and passed the relevant notes to the service team so they can look at what happened before the next departure cycle.

<<FACT F109>> We know that compensation cannot undo the delay, but it is part of making sure the inconvenience is acknowledged in a fair and consistent way. If your pet had any special handling needs during the wait, that matters to us as well, because those details help us improve how we brief crews and prepare the boarding flow for future travel. Our goal is always to keep the process respectful, practical, and predictable, even when operations are disrupted.

We also want to reassure you that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is working with the operations side to tighten the handoff between passenger care and animal care. That means clearer status updates, better visibility for the crew, and faster escalation when a departure starts to move. We expect our teams to communicate promptly and courteously, and we are reinforcing that standard wherever we see gaps.

If you choose to travel with Aurelia Skyways again, please let us know in advance about any comfort or handling concerns for your companion animal. While we cannot remove every disruption from air travel, we can make sure the right people are aware and prepared. Thank you for taking the time to speak up; feedback like yours helps us keep the service safer and more dependable for all travelers.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
